name: Unified Search / Index Core Foundation

proposal_baseline.base_approval: USER-DIRECTED: current remote-synced integration HEAD discovered at execution time; registry row applied on the dedicated branch by explicit user direction on 2026-10-02 to unblock shared host CI, following the notify-01/job-01/ident-01 precedent

registry_entry.activation_gate: Host provider/index contract, ledger, reference backend, and tests may be prepared on this dedicated branch. Daemon/IPC wiring, guest durable index, production provider registration (Files/Notes/Activity/Wayback/Albert), Home/Search UI, production capability wiring, and semantic/model paths require Nagi 0.1 M30 PASS and an explicit Integration Owner checkpoint naming SEARCH-CORE-01.
registry_entry.merge_boundary: Dedicated codex/0.2-search-core-01 branch only; integrate through an explicit checkpoint after the canonical 0.1 nagi-search crate is on the integration base. Never merge directly to main or another workstream branch.

canonical_dependency.pinned_source: git https://github.com/RT-NISH/NagiOS rev de3092c6a0125e45ea0b1f5f70c6d62c0c33f7fa (codex/m19-m22-continuation HEAD at audit time)
canonical_dependency.reason: The canonical Search/Index contract is not yet on codex/integration-next-phase. Copying it would fork the contract; a path dependency would require editing 0.1-owned paths. An exact-revision git pin is reproducible and read-only.
canonical_dependency.integration_action: When user/nagi-search lands on the integration base, replace both git pins in crates/nagi-search-core/Cargo.toml with path dependencies (../../user/nagi-search, ../nagi-model), regenerate crates/nagi-search-core/Cargo.lock, and re-run the acceptance suite. If the 0.1 contract changes incompatibly before then, bump the pin and adapt this crate; never patch the 0.1 crate from this workstream.
canonical_dependency.risk: If the pinned commit becomes unreachable (history rewrite of the 0.1 branch), a clean checkout cannot fetch it. Integration should pin to a commit reachable from an immutable ref.

proposed_host_test_command.note: 29 host acceptance tests pass with the repository-pinned nightly-2025-08-01 toolchain on x86_64 Linux. The first build requires network access once to fetch the pinned git revision. Host results do not establish daemon, IPC, guest persistence, provider adoption, UI, or target acceptance.

integration_owner_actions: Review the registry row already applied on this dedicated branch by user direction when selecting the next integration checkpoint.

Commit the user-supplied master documents Nagi_OS_0.2_Codex_Implementation_Spec.md and Nagi_OS_0.2_Parallel_Execution_Rules.md under docs/0.2/ (integration-owned); their SHA-256 values are recorded in AUDIT.md.
Decide whether SEARCH-CORE-01 maps to the unassigned platform-apis workstream for 0.2-M19 or stays a separate registered stream.

Reconcile provider identity: this foundation binds providers to the canonical AppId; nagi-home-search (M26 track) defines a separate string ProviderId. One canonical provider identity should be chosen before Home/Search adopts the ingestion boundary.
Bring user/nagi-search onto the integration base after its 0.1 milestone allows it, then switch the git pins to path dependencies.

After Nagi 0.1 M30 PASS and an explicit checkpoint naming SEARCH-CORE-01: bind ProviderAuthority to the Capability/Permissions search.provider decision, bind VisibilityFilter/AccessContext to authenticated caller/session context, add guest durable snapshot backends, wire service IPC, and adopt Files/Notes/Activity/Wayback providers.

contract_change_proposals.target_owner: Nagi 0.1 M19 Search line / later 0.2-M19 platform-apis
contract_change_proposals.proposal: Lexical body-text (content) indexing is not part of the canonical MetadataRecord; providers can only expose bounded title/tags/attributes. A bounded body-text field and matcher belong in the canonical crate, not in a parallel SEARCH-CORE index.

MetadataRecord has no revision marker. SEARCH-CORE-01 keeps revisions in its own ledger; carrying the revision in the canonical record would let the metadata snapshot and the ledger commit atomically.

scope_notes: The only hard registry dependency is development-foundation. The 0.1 nagi-search crate is consumed read-only at a fixed revision and is not edited.
No root workspace, root lockfile, shared CI, shared schema, IDL/ABI, user/**, apps/**, sdk/**, or other workstream state is changed. The crate has its own [workspace] and Cargo.lock.
Caller visibility is the canonical injected VisibilityFilter; provider authorization is an injected ProviderAuthority. Neither forks the Capability/Permissions engine. Tests use host-only mocks.
MemorySnapshotBackend is host reference storage, not production persistence.
The registry row is applied on codex/0.2-search-core-01 by explicit user direction; this is the only shared-file change. The Integration Owner still reviews it at the integration checkpoint.
Merged codex/integration-next-phase b3076db (CLIP-01 checkpoint); the registry rows for clip-01 and search-core-01 coexist without edits.

ci_proposal.reason: The crate is standalone and not a root workspace member, so shared CI does not compile or run its acceptance suite.
ci_proposal.ownership_note: A later Integration Owner/CI-acceptance checkpoint should apply this; .github/workflows/ci.yml is forbidden to this workstream. Until the git pins become path dependencies, the CI job needs network access to github.com for the first fetch.
ci_proposal.placement: Add as a 'Standalone search core (SEARCH-CORE-01)' step next to the 'Standalone clipboard core (CLIP-01)' step in the ubuntu-host job of .github/workflows/ci.yml (integration b3076db).
